purpose: Reduce development-scoring cost while preserving the locked official evaluator for the prospective benchmark result.
artifact_contract: development scores are written as sidecars and never mutate source trajectories
every sidecar is bound to the trajectory, task definition, prompt hashes, model revision, and decoding contract
development sidecars cannot be represented as official STATE-Bench scores
qualification_before_candidate_freeze: freeze a train-side calibration panel before inspecting open-judge agreement
score the same trajectory evidence with the protocol-locked GPT-5.4 judge
report agreement, confusion counts, and disagreement rates by task family
manually audit every disagreement without changing either judge output
freeze an acceptance or abstention decision before candidate construction
official_evaluation: The complete prospective test continues to use the protocol-locked GPT-5.4 simulator and judge.
